feeding increasing proportions barley grain in a TMR affected diurnal plasma metabolites in high-producing dairy cattle, and that the concomitant increases of glucose, lactates and NEFA, as well as the decreased plasma cholesterol in cows receiving the most barley grain, suggests that high inclusion of grain may play a role in diurnal patterns of metabolic fluctuations in dairy cattle.

the effects of feeding high proportions of barley in the diet on diurnal patterns in plasma metabolites of lactating dairy cows.
